D\'Genius Solutions

Social Media Executive

A creative and enthusiastic Social Media Executive passionate about content creation, digital trends, and building engaging online communities. This role involves day-to-day posting, content scheduling, community engagement, trend research, and basic performance reporting across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn for D'Genius Solutions.

Part 1: 10 Situational Questions Part 2: 15 MCQs · 3 Short Answers · 1 Long Answers ~45–60 minutes

Part 1 of 2 — Situational Questions
Part 2 of 2 — Knowledge Assessment
⏰ 00:00
No internet access. Answer independently.

Section A — Multiple Choice

15 marks
1What does 'Reach' primarily measure in social media analytics?
A. The total number of times your content was displayed.
B. The number of unique users who saw your content.
C. The number of likes and comments your post received.
D. The percentage of your followers who saw your content.
2Which content format on Instagram is best suited for quick, interactive polls or quizzes that disappear after 24 hours?
A. Instagram Feed Post
B. Instagram Reel
C. Instagram Story
D. IGTV Video
3When crafting a compelling social media caption, what is generally recommended regarding the placement of the Call-to-Action (CTA)?
A. Bury it at the very end of a long paragraph.
B. Place it prominently at the beginning or end of the caption, making it clear and concise.
C. Avoid using a CTA in most social media captions.
D. Only use emojis as a CTA.
4Which feature within Meta Business Suite is most useful for planning and visualizing your content schedule across Facebook and Instagram?
A. Inbox
B. Monetization
C. Content Planner/Calendar
D. Ads Manager
5If a user posts a highly negative but legitimate review on your client's Facebook page, what is the best initial course of action?
A. Delete the review immediately to protect the brand's image.
B. Publicly argue with the user to defend the brand's reputation.
C. Acknowledge the feedback publicly, apologize for their experience, and offer to resolve the issue via private message or email.
D. Ignore the review and hope it gets buried by other posts.
6For a B2C fashion brand targeting young adults, which platform is generally considered most visually-driven and effective for showcasing products through short videos and aspirational imagery?
A. LinkedIn
B. Facebook (primarily groups)
C. Instagram
D. Twitter (now X)
7What is a 'meme' in the context of social media content?
A. A long-form documentary about internet culture.
B. A type of sponsored advertisement.
C. An image, video, piece of text, etc., typically humorous in nature, that is copied and spread rapidly by internet users, often with slight variations.
D. A formal academic paper published online.
8Why is it important to use consistent profile pictures and cover photos across all social media platforms for a brand?
A. It allows you to use the same content on every platform without any changes.
B. It helps build a strong, recognizable brand identity and fosters trust and familiarity with the audience.
C. It reduces the need for any content planning.
D. It makes it harder for competitors to copy your strategy.
9If you need to quickly resize an image for different social media platforms without losing quality, which tool or feature would be most helpful?
A. A complex video editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro.
B. Canva's 'Magic Resize' feature or similar functionality in other online design tools.
C. A spreadsheet program like Microsoft Excel.
D. A word processing application like Google Docs.
10How can an AI-powered content generator assist a Social Media Executive in drafting captions?
A. By fully automating all creative processes without human input.
B. By generating complex video animations from scratch.
C. By providing initial caption drafts, suggesting different tones, or expanding on bullet points, which can then be refined by the executive.
D. By replacing the need for audience engagement.
11What is the main purpose of 'boosting' a Facebook post?
A. To automatically delete the post after 24 hours.
B. To increase the organic reach of the post to your existing followers only.
C. To pay to show your post to a wider, targeted audience beyond your existing followers.
D. To convert the post into a long-form article.
12Before publishing a carousel post with multiple images, what specific check is crucial for the visuals?
A. Ensure all images are exactly the same size and aspect ratio.
B. Verify the images are in the correct sequence and visually cohesive.
C. Check if the images contain hidden messages.
D. Make sure the images are compressed to the lowest possible quality.
13How can AI tools help in identifying trending hashtags for a specific campaign?
A. By physically creating new hashtags that don't exist.
B. By analyzing vast amounts of social media data to identify popular and relevant hashtags related to your content and industry.
C. By randomly generating a list of common words.
D. By only suggesting hashtags that are already overused.
14When analyzing a competitor's social media presence, what key aspect helps you understand their audience engagement strategy?
A. The number of employees they have.
B. The type of content that receives the most likes, comments, and shares, and how they respond to interactions.
C. Their annual revenue reports.
D. The physical location of their headquarters.
15What is a potential limitation of relying solely on AI for generating creative content ideas?
A. AI can generate too many ideas, making selection difficult.
B. AI may lack true human creativity, emotional intelligence, and understanding of nuanced cultural contexts, leading to generic or off-brand suggestions.
C. AI-generated ideas are always too complex to execute.
D. AI cannot generate ideas for visual content.

Section B — Short Answers

3 questions
B1Imagine you're managing social media for a local bookstore, 'Page Turners.' Propose three distinct content ideas for their Instagram feed, explaining how each would engage their audience (local book lovers) and promote reading.
B2A client expresses dissatisfaction, stating, 'Our social media isn't generating enough leads.' How would you respond to this, and what steps would you take to address their concern, given your role as a Social Media Executive?
B3Describe your step-by-step process for planning and organizing content for a full week across Instagram and Facebook, specifically mentioning how you would use a content calendar and Meta Business Suite to ensure timely and consistent posting.

Section C — Long Answer

1 question(s)
C1D'Genius Solutions has secured 'GreenHarvest,' an organic food delivery service targeting busy urban professionals. Develop a 3-month social media strategy for GreenHarvest across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Your strategy should focus on building brand trust, showcasing product freshness, and driving subscriptions. Detail content pillars, specific content formats for each platform, suggested posting frequency, and key engagement tactics. Crucially, explain how you would leverage basic AI tools (e.g., for content ideas, caption drafts, trend analysis, image optimization suggestions) to enhance this strategy.
Minimum 150 words.
